sections.translation:
### Software Update

UX24 models **manufactured from 2023 onwards** allow software updates by accessing the web interface from a computer with Internet access.\
For earlier models that do not include this feature, please write to: [**info@solidyne.ar**](mailto:info@solidyne.ar).

**Components that can be updated:**

- Mixing engine firmware (hardware).
- Graphical interface.
- Streaming tools.
sections.title: Actualización de software

sections.translation: #### Update Procedure 1. Connect the **Ethernet Streaming Out** and **Remote Control** ports of the console to the local network. 2. Ensure the network has **Internet access**. 3. On the console's main screen, verify the IP address assigned to **STREAMING IP**. 4. In the browser, enter the IP address followed by `/update`.\ Example: `192.168.0.88/update` 5. Press **Enter** to open the update screen. 6. Click **CHECK FOR UPDATES**. 7. If there are no updates, the system will report that it is up to date. 8. If updates are available, a list with details will be displayed. 9. Updates **are not installed automatically**. 10. To install an update, press **INSTALL**. Depending on the type of update, the console may restart, interrupting the on-air signal for a few seconds.
sections.title: Procedimiento de actualización
